name: Granite Internet Services
summary: South Australian regional ISP (granite.net.au) serving the Fleurieu Peninsula; acquired by iiNet in 2002.

events.details: Acquired by iiNet in its 2002 regional acquisition round. The earlier 'userbase mostly to RuralNet' note was wrong - RuralNet (Mildura VIC) was itself acquired by iiNet (announced 31 Dec 2002).
